messages:
alyssa: quick sanity check — seeing intermittent SM% drop (~40% -> ~10%) on pool-gpu-prod-3 when autoscaler bumps batchsize to 12. KV cache evictions spike at the same time. Where are the canonical grafana panels/traces/logs? need panel ids + owner so i can open a tiny alert-tuning PR.

devon: @alyssa panels: GPU throughput dashboard -> https://grafana.redwood.company/d/gpu-throughput (panel 42 = SM%, panel 57 = batch-size histogram). KV cache evictions panel -> https://grafana.redwood.company/d/kvcache (panel 9). Traces: https://jaeger.redwood.company/search?service=runtime&operation=kv-evict .

devon: quick prom queries that are usually helpful:
```
sum(rate(gpu_sm_utilization[1m])) by (pool)
sum(rate(kvcache_evictions_total[5m])) by (pool)
```
logs (kubectl): `kubectl logs -n runtime pod/<pod-name> -c runtime --since=10m | grep Eviction`

alyssa: perfect — thanks. any idea who owns the SM% alert in prod? iirc it triggers at sm_util < 15% for 10m but maybe config changed.

sara: i own that alert. current definition in prod: `SM_UTIL_LOW` -> sm_utilization < 15 for 10m on any pool. we debated tightening before. if dips are correlated with KV evictions we should avoid noisy paging. happy to take a look.

jordan: fwiw batchsize 12 change landed in canary last week (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/789). larger batches increase memory pressure and make cold kv misses look worse in SM%. not surprising to see short-lived dips.

sara: proposal: modify alert to require both conditions: sm_util < 12% for 10m AND kvcache_evictions_rate > 5 (per-pool). That would suppress pure-batching noise. i'll draft a PR.

devon: if you want to target the grafana alerts, panel ids above. also can add panel links to sample traces; i can drop anchors to jaeger trace ids for typical evictions.

deploy-bot: release job finished: runtime v1.23.4 — canary rolled to pool-gpu-prod-3 (build 4832).

alyssa: thanks. @sara please ping when PR is up. i'll also add a note + link to the ops runbook (ops/playbooks/gpu-sm.md) so oncall knows the correlation.

sara: will open PR in ~30m and set the alert to be conditional (kvcache_evictions_rate > 5 && sm_util < 12% for 10m). i'll include rationale and a grafana screenshot.

devon: happy to review grafana JSON and add trace anchors after the PR.

alyssa: awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
